MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest' AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT p, t, c,
  CASE
    WHEN contains(p.birth_date, '/') THEN
      2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - CASE
        WHEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 10
          OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) > 14)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    WHEN contains(p.birth_date, ',') THEN
      2026 - CAST(trim(split_part(p.birth_date, ',', 2)) AS INT64) - CASE
        WHEN CASE split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 1)
          WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3
          WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6
          WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9
          WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12
          ELSE 0 END > 10
          OR (CASE split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 1)
            WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3
            WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6
            WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9
            WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12
            ELSE 0 END = 10
            AND CAST(split_part(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', 1) AS INT64) > 14)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ELSE 2026 - CAST(trim(p.birth_date) AS INT64)
  END AS age
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, age AS col2, c.city_name AS col3, t.team_name AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team
